title: Amazon captures nearly a quarter of US pet sales through first-party vendors
summary: First-party (1P) vendors selling pet products directly to Amazon account for 23.4% of the monthly average revenue for the pet category on the platform in the US. This represents a monthly income of $322 million (€279M), …
ai_summary: Amazon’s first‑party vendors now account for 23.4% of the monthly average revenue in the US pet category on the platform, equating to about $322 million per month. This represents a significant share of the overall pet sales captured by Amazon’s direct sales channel.
